summary: The g4sim field-propagation benchmark of geant4_benchmarks.py ran the analytic helix backwards in a negative field (field_tesla < 0), so a correct propagation failed and its verdict was wrong.

database_specific.introduced_basis: 0.60.0 is the first release with the g4sim path of field-propagation (bench_field_g4sim, commit df01e78e); geant4_benchmarks.py existed since 0.19.0 without it

observables: the verdict and largest in-plane distance (geant4) of field-propagation benchmarks on the g4sim path
impact.bias: for B < 0 the reference crossings were mirrored back along the initial direction with the bend on the wrong side: a correct propagation failed by about 1.8e6 um at 1 T (audit run), and a propagation bending the wrong way could pass; B > 0 was right
impact.trigger: a field-propagation benchmark with ir and primaries (the g4sim path) and field_tesla < 0

applies_to.match_basis: a Geant4 study record (check_geant4_study.py) embeds the benchmark results of geant4_benchmarks.py in extension.study.benchmarks; a record that lists one of these benchmarks was evaluated by the affected code

outputs.how_to_recognize: geant4_benchmarks.py run output (JSON) with a field-propagation benchmark whose config gives field_tesla < 0 and ir/primaries

remedy: rerun geant4_benchmarks.py with this version on negative-field g4sim studies; positive-field studies are unchanged
